- Experience in system design or orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI).
- Experience structuring technical delivery roadmaps, managing production deployments, and interfacing with product or engineering organizations.
- Ability to communicate in English and Spanish fluently to engage with regional enterprise customers and global product teams.

## Diferenciais:

- Lead technical onboarding, environment readiness (capacity, quotas, security, IAM/SSO, enterprise connectors, ECMs, and data residency), and organizational change management required to operationalize AI-driven workflows into daily production.
